title: 행정안전부장관의 소속청장 지휘에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:1:0:00001:part:1/1
full_text: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of these Rules is to prescribe matters necessary for the Minister of the Interior and Safety to direct the Commissioner General of the Korean National Police Agency and the Commissioner of the National Fire Agency under the Minister's jurisdiction pursuant to Article 7 (4) of the Government Organization Act.
